meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把项目的完整历史按 ISO 周拆成每周一个文件，再按时间顺序逐周启用子代理，每周产出一章叙事摘要，每章继承上一周的 carry-forward 块，章节总数等于时间线覆盖的 ISO 周数。
howto.when: 当你提到「weekly digests」「week-by-week story」等关键词，或要求按周连载某项目的历史时触发；若你想要的是单篇长篇报告，应改用 timeline-report。

howto.what_en: Claude splits a project's full claude-mem timeline into one file per ISO week, then runs one subagent per week in order; each chapter inherits the prior week's carry-forward block. Chapter count equals the ISO weeks covered.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline" etc., or want a project's history told as serial weekly chapters. For one long report, use timeline-report instead.

say_en.text: Continue the story week by week from where we left off
